upstream_title: Study Data Tabulation Model Implementation Guide: Human Clinical Trials
upstream_version: SDTMIG 3.4 Final, published 2021-11-29; PDF re-issued 2022-07-21 with image clarity updates; intended for use with SDTM v2.0
capture_method: official CDISC release page inspection; project-authored metadata and paraphrased evidence only

locators.claim: The release identifies SDTMIG 3.4, its publication date, its relationship to SDTM v2.0, and its role in organizing tabulation datasets.
The anonymous release page requires sign-in or sign-up before it exposes the standard files or CDISC Library link.
The release page publishes corrections that must remain companion evidence rather than silently replacing the PDF wording.
Known issues are separately identified and must not be interpreted as approved PDF text.

dependencies.title: SDTM and SDTMIG Conformance Rules v2.0

rights_note: The original PDF and XLSX are stored as restricted, local-only source artifacts and are excluded from Git. Upstream CDISC terms govern both files.
